rationale: I independently read the entire held EO 11352 extract and entire EO 11437 extract, rather than relying on the generated snapshot or producer paraphrase. The original header, title, May 22, 1967 date and 32 FR 7563 citation identify EO 11352: one operative paragraph suspends only the Marine Corps lieutenant-colonel service-in-grade requirement under 10 USC 5751(b), using 5785(b). EO 11437 at 33 FR 17945 both independently suspends the broader 5751(b) provisions and expressly names Executive Order No. 11352 of May 22,1967 in the sentence ending are hereby revoked. That actor verb reaches the named order without a section limitation; the original partial statutory scope is not an exception to its whole-order revocation. The broader replacement suspension is an independent command of EO 11437, not continuing authority under EO 11352. Neither inspected original nor actor text contains an express savings clause or another independent command of EO 11352. Earlier-end inspection is bounded: I checked the complete original for own-term sunset/trigger/independent commands and the supplied acting chain, but have not established every earlier statutory change. Thus I accept this exact producer sheet only as a nonauthoritative provisional NO proposal for owner consideration and an experimental working dossier. I do not establish first-effective cessation, an effective date from the signing/publication dates, extinguishment of historical promotion rights or accrued applications, absence of later revival, or a complete legal status through 2026-10-14. Those remain lifecycle gaps. The actual held API fields and 1989 OCR row agree editorially, but they supply no independent operative status basis. Source checks used exact held UTF-8 bytes, not page images; original_pages_confirmed remains false. No authoritative status, accepted interval, completed lifecycle, or human certification follows from this review.
